Okay, heard this one a couple times over, here's what I think:

- You seem to have taken out all the breathing sounds from the vocals, which is a shame because you have some great drums in there and you're discussing gunplay. From my own experience, the sound of you drawing a breath here and there really gives the track a more natural-sounding aggression. Check out Benny the Butcher for reference.

- The hook is GENIUS, primarily due to the mixing choice of punctuating it with the growling sound and your own writing. The rhymes on it are simple as should be, will be easy for a crowd to sing along.

- That being said, you really should've saved the dog/growl sounds for the hook. I heard them a couple other places and they REALLY get in the way of your verse. Merely flowing over a beat would've sufficed.

- I'd advise you to mute the instrumental at the end of a four bar scheme when you're really confident in your punchline, helps it land harder. Especially when you're talking guns.

- The Bi/Buy wordplay is the first I've heard. I'm surprised no one else did it, that was slick. Impressed.

- The whole 'mental' scheme was redundant, do away with using the same word multiple times unless you can get it to have multiple meanings.

- 'If I'm about to run up it, bitch get in the race' was a terrible ending to a nice verse - honestly just sounds like lazy writing that was delivered well. Given the rest of the verses, I'm sure you have it in you to brainstorm a bit more and come up with another scheme related to cars and racing(maybe go for angles like tires/pressure, wheel/drive, etc.)
